subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

His knowledge is __superficial__ in nature.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Profound**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Superficial **means shallow or lacking depth. (उथला या गहराई का अभाव)

 
 
• **Example**: *Wearing only a superficial smile, she concealed the depth of her emotions.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Profound **means deep or thorough. (गहरा या संपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *His profound understanding of the subject impressed the entire class.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of superficial is profound.

Therefore, **Option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deviant **means different or abnormal. (भिन्न या असामान्य)
 
• **Artificial **means fake or not natural. (नकली या प्राकृतिक नहीं)
 
• **Opposing **means conflicting or contrary. (परस्पर विरोधी या विपरीत)

189:T9bd,
The correct answer is: "**revolves**".
